        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(not data.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data[self.aapl]

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        elif aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            return

        current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > 0
                and spy_bar.Close < current_spy_sma
            )

            if spy_crosses_below and self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 70:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > current_spy_sma
            )

            if spy_crosses_above and self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
                shares = int(
                    math.floor(
                        0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_bar.Close
                    )
                )
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.ContainsKey(symbol) or data[symbol] is None:
                return
            bars[symbol] = data[symbol]

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if (
            self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
        ):
            spy_crossed_below = (
                self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )
            spy_crossed_above = (
                self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
                quantity = int(
                    math.floor(
                        (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                        / spy_bar.Close
                    )
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 70:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
            ):
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.Close

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.rsi_threshold = 70.0

        symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in symbols):
            self._update_state(data)
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        spy_sma_ready = self.sma.IsReady
        rsi_ready = self.rsi.IsReady

        spy_buy = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close > self.sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_sell = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close < self.sma.Current.Value
        )

        aapl_sell = (
            rsi_ready
            and self.rsi.Current.Value > self.rsi_threshold
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_buy:
            quantity = int(math.floor(
                0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close
            ))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_state(data)

    def _update_state(self, data: Slice):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = close

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.sma.IsReady:
            self.spy_previous_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.spy_previous_sma = self.sma.Current.Value
